HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 2
DOE v. HARBOR LABS, INC. Report of Ed Expert, for Plaintiff, October 1, 2013
I was asked what the 214,684 repurchased shares were worth on the June 12, 2012
repurchase date.
The only arm's-length price I have before that date is the $3.75 a share Alder Peak
paid in June 2011.
At that price the shares come to $805,065.00. The company paid $2,683.55.
The difference, in my opinion, is $802,381.45.

HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 2 of 2
Limits of this report
I have not valued the conversion discount added to the bridge note. I have not been
asked to.
I have not adjusted for the stalled bookings shown in the March 2012 board packet. A
lower share price would lower my number.
My fee is $375 an hour. It does not depend on the outcome.
